breakpoints.note: On the witnessed subset path, `drop_ot_layout` is false, so `_populate_gids_to_retain()` calls `_gsub_closure()` and dispatches attacker-controlled GSUB lookups.
The first vulnerability-relevant read on the crashing path resolves the attacker-controlled ligature-subtable `coverage` offset into the specific `Coverage` object later copied out of bounds.

The vulnerable helper takes the font-backed `Coverage` object by value as ctor-local `t1` instead of by reference, so constructing `hb_auto_t<Coverage::Iter>` copies the short blob-end object past the heap extent that sanitization allocated for the GSUB table.
